market_summary: Midday Tuesday (US close not yet in) chips gave back part of Monday's Huang-return rally: Nasdaq down 1.5-2.4% depending on source, SOX -6.2%, NVDA about -7%, MU about -10%, while the Dow edged higher. Reports cited a chip tariff story and AI-spend doubts. The 10-year eased to about 4.92% even with futures pricing about 95% odds of a 25bp Fed hike on Dec 9. GPU rents and DRAM spot held flat, so the selloff is in equities, not compute pricing.

headlines: Chips unwind part of Monday's surge midday Tue: NVDA about -7%, MU -10%, MRVL -9%, SOX -6%.
AI hardware watchlist hit hardest: ALAB -12%, AMD -9%, SKHY -9%; NET and MELI flat.
Fed hike Dec 9 priced at about 95%; 10-year eased to about 4.92%.
H100 rent flat week on week at highs; the earlier +7% read was overstated.
US GDP and PCE Wed 8:30am ET = Thu 12:30am AEDT; Dell, HP, Workday results land Wed morning AEDT.
